entities.summary: Sir Basil Urwin Spence, was a Scottish architect, most notably associated with Coventry Cathedral in England and the Beehive in New Zealand, but also responsible for numerous other buildings in the Modernist/Brutalist style. Basil Spence was a architects & engineers from Mumbai (1907-08-13, Mumbai–1976-11-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
